return {
  model: "phi-3-mini-4k-instruct",
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: `
You are an expert engineering manager and business analyst.
You MUST ALWAYS respond in STRICT VALID JSON — nothing else.
Your output must contain:
- NO markdown
- NO explanations outside the JSON field "reason"
- NO comments
- NO leading/trailing text
- NO missing keys
- NO trailing commas
If uncertain, return empty strings for values but keep schema intact.
`
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
        "Estimate effort using T-shirt sizing.\n" +
        "Refer to effort_size_map for unit & size mapping.\n\n" +

        "1. Feature Title:\n" +
        $json.featureTitle + "\n\n" +

        "2. Feature Description:\n" +
        $json.featureDescription + "\n\n" +

        "3. Additional Instructions:\n" +
        $json.additionalInstructions + "\n\n" +

        "4. Effort Unit:\n" +
        (
          $json.effort_unit
          ? $json.effort_unit
          : "days"
        ) + "\n\n" +

        "5. Effort Size Map:\n" +
        (
          $json.effort_size_map
          ? $json.effort_size_map
          : `{
  "XS": 2,
  "S": 4,
  "M": 6,
  "L": 8,
  "XL": 10,
  "XXL": 12
}`
        ) + "\n\n" +

        "BUFFER RULES:\n" +
        "- ComplexityBuffer: 0–30% (numeric only)\n" +
        "- IntegrationBuffer: 0–20% (numeric only)\n" +
        "- RequirementsClarityBuffer: 0–30% (numeric only)\n" +
        "- If unsure, return empty values.\n\n" +

        "OUTPUT RULES:\n" +
        "- Provide reasoning **inside the JSON field** named \"reason\".\n" +
        "- Output MUST match this exact schema:\n" +
        `{
  "effortSize": "string",
  "complexityBuffer": "string",
  "integrationBuffer": "string",
  "requirementsClarityBuffer": "string",
  "reason": "string"
}` +
        "\n" +
        "Return STRICT JSON only."
    }
  ]
};
